title: TLS: support decoding Trusted CA keys extension
description:
Add more complete support of the trusted_ca_keys extension,
defined in https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6066.html#section-6

notes.body:
Look good,

can you fix:
packet-tls-utils.c:9806:21: error: label followed by a declaration is a C23 extension [clang-diagnostic-c23-extensions]

can you share also a pcap with this extension ?

Thanks for the comments!

Error should be fixed.

pcap that contains all types of Trusted Ca indication types is [TLS_trusted_ca_keys.pcapng](/uploads/97b63c6721d9610183b3af545b7235e4/TLS_trusted_ca_keys.pcapng)
use trusted_ca.keys_length for display filter ? (same after)

I'm wondering what would be the latest guideline?

Basically as you will be able to see using the PCAP, the trusted_ca_keys extension is a list of "Trusted CA key" object.
Currently, we've got the following tree:

```
. trusted_ca_keys_length
. trusted_ca_keys
  . trusted_ca_key
    . trusted_ca_key_<specific parameter depending on type>
```

If I understand correctly your suggestion, we should split at the `trusted_ca` part? So we'll have for example, `. trusted_ca.keys_length` (plural) for the length of the extension and `. trusted_ca.key_type` (singular) for the type of a given CA keys?
I'm asking because I've followed what is done in eg. the "Signature Algorithms" extension.

I've also moved the filters under the `.handshake` prefix to follow what's done for other extensions. But I see that some are under the `.handshake.extensions` or `.handshake_extensions_` prefix (such as the session ticket or the supported groups ones), so what would be the best to use here?

Thanks!

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16997/diffs?diff_id=1104749876&start_sha=c0fe893a07bad823507c2d719472b7fec04793fa#154b33191b21d36cdcd9cc72b404632b2a2be550_2548_2548)

yes, it is a splut trusted_ca

no really guideline :)

i not sure if handshake is really needed...

Thanks.

I've split the filter but left the `.handshake` prefix for now. Let me know if you prefer that I remove it!
